content_html:
Flexible Metal Hose

Precision corrugated stainless steel flexible hose assemblies designed for severe thermal cycles, extreme high pressures, cryogenic media, and gas-tight fluid transfer. PT Misuba Guna Indonesia custom fabricates flexible metal hoses using annular corrugated thin-wall stainless steel tubing (SS304, SS316L, or SS321) encased in single or double high-density stainless steel wire braiding (SS304 or SS316).

Every hose assembly is TIG welded with custom end fittings, offering 100% leak-proof flexibility where rubber or synthetic hoses fail due to high temperature, chemical attack, or flame exposure.

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

Looking for custom flexible metal hose assemblies with quick turnaround? Provide your hose size (DN), overall length (OAL), working pressure, operating temperature, and end fitting configuration (e.g. Swivel Flange, Union, Male NPT, Tri-clamp). Our welding shop builds and hydrostatic tests every assembly prior to shipment.
